QuestInfo.name: A Favor for Marguerite
QuestInfo.0: Marguerite wants to tell you something.
QuestInfo.1: Marguerite wants you to get her a Snake Leather Bag. For that, you'll need to hunt Serpents near Edelstein. \n\n#i4033231##t4033231#  #b#c4033231##k/1
QuestInfo.2: Marguerite gave you a chair in exchange for the Snake Leather Bag. Was this her plan all along? Nah, she just really wanted that bag...

0.0: How could you?! You're off giving fancy bags to ladies in Edelstein, but you don't give a single one of your employees a nice treat?! You're so cheap!\r\n#L0##bWhat are you ranting about? I didn't give anyone a gift. I had to trick a woman while I was investigating her...#l\n#k
0.1: We work all day and night to make sure you have the best airship in the world and you go giving presents to people you don't even like! I'm going to... I don't know, organize a strike!\r\n#L0##bI'm telling you, that's not how it is! Look, is your salary too low? You can have a raise. Whatever you want, just stop yelling.#l\n#k
0.2: I don't WANT a ra-I mean, okay! But that's not all. You have to get me a bag too. I'll turn the Lumiere into a big floating pile of garbage unless you get me a bag!

yes.0: I thought you'd see things my way. Just go back to Edelstein and beat up a Serpent and bring me a nice new Snake Leather Bag. That's easy enough, isn't it?

no.0: You wanna play hardball, do you? Well say goodbye to clean sheets FOREVER!

1.0: This is a good start. Don't forget your employees next time you're running around town.

yes.0: I felt bad about all the yelling, so I took some of that huge raise you gave me and got you a chair! Isn't it nice. It'll look so good on you. Or, you know what I mean...

item.0: I want a GENUINE Snake Leather Bag from the Serpents in Edelstein. No substitutes!
